title: platanthera citrina
intro: Platanthera citrina, commonly known as the yellow bog orchid, is a species of terrestrial orchid. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Platanthera citrina include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
